name: Redpanda
tagline: Topics, Schema Registry and access control for Redpanda and Kafka. Never deletes, never shrinks partitions.

features.title: Topics, schemas, users, ACLs
features.body: Idempotent provisioning of topics, Schema Registry schemas, SASL users and ACLs.

features.title: Never destructive
features.body: Never deletes topics, schemas, users or ACLs that are not in the config, and warns instead of decreasing a partition count.

features.title: Resilient and observable
features.body: Exponential backoff for broker and Schema Registry connectivity; structured JSON logs.
